kind: Real Cubism Core UV, triangle and selected parameter sample inspection
observations: Source pixel extents are computed from model coordinates times pixelsPerUnit, not screenshot/display pixels.
All samples reset other parameters to defaults before Core.update().
Triangle degeneracy and orientation counts are geometry diagnostics, not visual-quality acceptance criteria.
limits: Only the explicitly supplied Core script identified by its SHA-256 was tested.
No browser rendering, AIRI import/persistence, motion playback, lip-sync timing, alpha-texture sampling, or combined parameter states were tested.
